datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field assessments across South Sudan to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Geographic data representing IPC classification zones were compiled into spatial datasets (GeoJSON/KML) for January, April, July, and October 2014, capturing near-term food security projections across administrative units.
